quality_effect: Prevents resampled products and DSM surface objects from being treated as independent bare-earth precision evidence.
official_facts: EA Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m spatial resolution.
The composite DTM removes surface objects to represent terrain surface.
The 2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Where repeat surveys exist, the newest best-resolution data is selected.
Where data is resampled, bilinear interpolation is used before merging.
The 2022 composite includes surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
EA Composite DTM 2m also covers about 99% of England at 2m spatial resolution.
EA Composite DTM 10m is resampled from the 2m composite using bilinear interpolation.
Therefore 10m DTM is not independent evidence from the 2m composite lineage.
Timestamped DSM includes heights of vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain.
DSM and DTM are not interchangeable for bare-earth elevation.
Timestamped DSM metadata includes survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model fields.
